name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small bathroom feel larger during a remodel, focus on design choices that create an illusion of space. Consider installing a wall-mounted vanity to free up floor space, choosing a glass shower enclosure instead of a curtain, and using lighter color palettes for walls and tiles. Strategic lighting, including recessed lights and a large mirror, can also enhance the perception of size. Using larger format tiles with minimal grout lines on the floor can also contribute to a more expansive feel by reducing visual clutter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Make a small bathroom feel larger with wall-mounted vanities, glass shower enclosures, light colors, and strategic lighting. Larger tiles with minimal grout also help.
